scope: Two CA processes on one Docker host; shared single PostgreSQL; opt-in managed client connection failover
database: Independent transport PKI, server verify-full + per-node mTLS client keys, scoped role, SERIALIZABLE transactions
retry_boundary: Fail over only during connection/TLS establishment on network failure; TLS authentication failures and sent POSTs do not retry
maintenance: Leaf publisher stays paused during controlled CA generation/configuration change; every node proves new issuer/JWK before migration and old JWK denial before retirement
limitations: No database replication/failover or multi-host HA
No zero-downtime authority-key ceremony or maintenance SLA
No HSM, anti-rollback, compromised-root recovery or active CRL/OCSP
No generic automatic retry of ambiguous write outcomes
No general claim of ACME/admin API transaction correctness
No automatic lifecycle rotation of the separate database transport PKI
